title: MiCAR Register Observatory Raw Export Manifest v1
description: data/raw/<snapshot_date>/manifest.json: the exports of one weekly refresh as downloaded, kept gzipped next to the manifest. Written from October 2026 on. Field meanings: docs/data-dictionary.md.

recorded_as.description: snapshot: recorded under data/snapshots/; quarantine: set aside under data/quarantine/.

file.description: The gzipped export, next to the manifest.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes as downloaded, before compression.

last_modified.description: The HTTP Last-Modified header, verbatim; empty when the server sent none.
